blocks.html:
This method retrieves the list of modules installed in a Medusa application,
excluding link modules. Use it to check whether an optional module, such as
RBAC, is installed.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: modules
children.description: The modules installed in the Medusa application, excluding link modules.

children.name: key
children.description: The module's key, such as `rbac` or a custom module's name.
